individuals.description:
Folders of single mods the player picked but has not added yet, so they
can be read and added later. A mod leaves this list when it is added.

libraries.description:
Folders that hold many mods, kept so their mods can be worked through
across sessions.

mods.description: In load order: earlier entries load first.

manifest.description: Path to the manifest JSON. Relative paths resolve against the profile file's folder.

root.description: Folder containing the mod's files. Relative paths resolve the same way.
